findings.detail: Same problem as M2-S54-T1. There, a field is empty because the source refers to a document the system never receives, and the reader must see why retries fail. Here, renewal_date is empty because the value is only in Schedule B, which is never provided. The same reasoning leads to correct option D. That option matches M2-S54-T1's correct conclusion about the master agreement. Two wrong options also repeat. Option B (a higher retry limit will eventually find the value) copies M2-S54-T1's option on raising the retry limit. Option A (error feedback cannot correct a date-format mismatch) restates M2-S54-T1's option that date failures persist under retry. The question is framed as a cause question, but the earlier question already tested this exact cause.

blind_answer.reason: Retries only help with format or structural errors. Here the renewal date is not in the provided input at all: it sits in Schedule B, an external document the pipeline never receives. So no amount of error feedback can produce the value (4.4-K2, 4.4-S2).
